name: Rayquaza Road (San Francisco)
summary: Howard Street in San Francisco has been temporarily renamed 'Rayquaza Road' for the 2026 Pokémon World Championships! Outdoor activation with themed food vendors, product demos, photo ops, and a life-sized Lego Rayquaza. Worlds tournament + PokémonXP fan festival at Moscone Center, Aug 28–30.
summary_ms: Howard Street di San Francisco ditukar nama sementara kepada 'Rayquaza Road' untuk Kejohanan Dunia Pokémon 2026! Aktiviti luar dengan vendor makanan bertema, demo produk, peluang foto, dan Lego Rayquaza bersaiz sebenar. Kejohanan Worlds + festival peminat PokémonXP di Moscone Center, 28–30 Ogos.

name: Celebrate with Hawlucha! (Mexico)
summary: Mexico only! Hawlucha arrives in Mexico from September 15 at 10:00 am to September 21 at 8:00 pm local time. Hawlucha appears more frequently in the wild, Incense lasts twice as long, and Hawlucha can also be found through Field Research and a Collection Challenge. Take on Timed Research and pick your side — train with Candela or with Arlo — with Hawlucha, XP, a Lucky Egg and a Star Piece as rewards on both paths.
summary_ms: Mexico sahaja! Hawlucha datang ke Mexico dari 15 September 10:00 pagi hingga 21 September 8:00 malam waktu tempatan. Hawlucha muncul lebih kerap di alam liar, Incense tahan dua kali lebih lama, dan Hawlucha juga boleh didapati melalui Field Research dan Collection Challenge. Sertai Timed Research dan pilih pihak anda — berlatih dengan Candela atau dengan Arlo — dengan Hawlucha, XP, Lucky Egg dan Star Piece sebagai ganjaran pada kedua-dua laluan.
